war ripple, called from SetStatus when a war is declared (flag 1): the victim score becomes min(score-50, 49); every other independent nation i changes its score with the aggressor by (90 - score[victim][i]) * old_score / (divisor*50) (divisor 2 neighbour minor / 4 other minor / 8 Great Power watching a minor; 4 or 8 when the victim is a Great Power), floored at 50 when it was already 50 or more. Reproduces the war on Pram seen in play: 90->40, neighbours 50, other minors -9, Great Powers unchanged
